rules.title: Rules
rules.lowestWins: The group with the lowest total time wins.
rules.finalTime: The final time is the sum of the times of all participants in the group.
rules.draw: After November 4, when registration closes, groups will be formed by random draw.
rules.newRule: A new rule applies after the first elimination
rules.sameTime: Participants in the same group can't play the same game at the same time.
rules.differentGames: Each one must play a different game, chosen from the allowed ones, in any category.
rules.categories: Categories follow the same rules as the Mega Man Leaderboards.
rules.consolesList: Snes9x 1.51 or newer, Bizhawk, PCSX, PCSX2, Duckstation.
rules.consolesBanned: No RetroArch, no VBA & VBA-core for Bizhawk.
rules.gamesBanned: No mods and no Legacy Collection. No IGT para X5 & X6.
